proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_attunement_restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: MagicItemRecord only exposes a boolean requiresAttunement flag, so it cannot encode who is eligible to attune. This item requires attunement specifically by a spellcaster.

notes: Core mechanics fit the current magic-item activation surface: holding-item gate, 7-charge pool, charge-scaled Fireball casting at levels 3-5 with fixed DC 15, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction roll. The only omitted rule is the attunement eligibility qualifier.
